## PRB1.7. Investments {#prb1.7.-investments .Heading-2-ER}

- ROMATSA planned a total asset value for new investments in RP4 of 99.4M€2022, of which 13.8% relates to new major investments. ROMATSA planned 2 new major investments for RP4, all of which have started.

- In 2025, ROMATSA overspent +0.1M€2022 (+759.2%) in costs related to new major investments. This is attributable to the re-phasing of the cash flows of the ATM system upgrade project.

- According to the reporting tables, ROMATSA underspent -0.2M€2022 (-0.9%) in costs related to investments in 2025. These amounts must be reimbursed to the airspace users through a reduction of future unit rate(s), unless the NSA decides after consultation with the users, that the ANSP must not reimburse a part of the difference according to article 28 of Regulation (EU) 2019/317.

- ROMATSA reported no funding from Union assistance programmes in 2025.
